paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Temporal variability of targets included in the literature. We see that there has been a gradual rise towards multi-target datasets.
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the distribution of targets over time, representing data from 2013 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the year, ranging from 2013 to 2022, with equally spaced tick labels for each year. The vertical axis, labeled "Targets," displays values ranging from 0 to 1 on a linear scale, with tick labels at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0. Each year is represented by a stacked bar, with distinct colors indicating different target ranges: blue for "0," orange for "1," green for "2-4," red for "5-7," and violet for "8+." In 2013, the blue bar representing "0" targets has an approximate height of 0.2, while the violet bar representing "8+" targets is approximately 0.05. As the years progress, the relative proportions of the stacked bars change; for instance, in 2022, the orange bar representing "1" targets appears to have a value near 0.2, while the violet bar shows a height of approximately 0.1. The bars are sorted chronologically by year, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color distinctions for each target category.
